'''Bimmiel''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in an elliptical orbit around its primary [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[MZX33291 system]]. The fifth planet in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], it was named after [[Bimmiel (Imperial)|Bimmiel]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who rediscovered it. As the planet neared the sun, its ice caps melted, triggering an increase in moisture and plant growth. The heat brought the native [[shwpi]] out of hibernation to multiply. Since the carnivorous [[slashrat]]s could not adapt to the heat, they retreated to the polar regions of the planet. Then when the planet got farther from the sun, its ice caps refroze, and the shwpi came into the food chain of the slashrats, returning to the equatorial regions. The slashrats brought the number of shwpi back to a manageable number. A number of natives existed on the planet, using crude wooden [[Spear/Legends|spears]] and tools.

==History==
At some time during the period of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were present on the world.

In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], members of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] landed on Bimmiel and began surveying the surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] for a future invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the Galactic Empire quarantined the planet.<ref name="NJOSB50" />

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] Dr. [[Anki Pace]] was sent to Bimmiel with a team including [[Jens (student)|Jens]], [[Vil (student)|Vil]], [[Trista Orlanis]], and [[Denna]]. The team uncovered the ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] artifacts, suspecting Jedi involvement in the thefts of the artifacts that left their guardians with years of memories erased. While on Bimmiel, they also discovered the mummified corpse of [[Mongei Shai]], a Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warrior]]. The team was captured by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] from a recently established spy and reconnaissance post on the planet. It was set up by scouts from [[Domain Shai]] on the orders of [[Zho Krazhmir]]. Denna and Vil were rescued by [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Ganner Rhysode]] shortly thereafter.<ref name="Dark Tide I">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>

Bimmiel would be among the first worlds to fall to the Vong as they swept through the Outer Rim. They would occupy the world through the remainder of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy.<ref name="TEA" />
